Totally understandable — data cleaning is mentally draining work, especially with 420 rows of messy inputs. Nice job getting through it.

When you're ready to pick it back up, the natural next steps would be things like:

- **Summary stats** (how many volunteers per park, Yes/No breakdown, etc.)

No rush at all. Come back whenever and we'll pick up where you left off.
